shared_adapter: native_knn_faiss_ivf_20261003/prepare_gts.py and gts_bench.cu: full IDs, MAX_H=6, 1GiB workspace, no timed console output

modes.G0: Unchanged original kNN with the shared complete-output adapter

deleted_equivalent_modes.G2: Original getDisPQ -> sort_by_key -> updateDisK already uses encountered pivot objects to tighten the legal bound
deleted_equivalent_modes.G3: No independent G2 mechanism is added; it would duplicate G1

invariants: same per-level pivot bound and node priority
bit-identical complete ordered IDs and distance fields G0/G1
no Graph, PAR, TILED, new layout or precision change
diagnostic_queries: First32 of the prior frozen GIST final256, not selected for reuse benefit

confirmation_queries.generation: only after code/parameters/mapping freeze; exclude inventoried historical in-dataset GIST IDs; disclose inventory incompleteness

timing_scope: Continuous host-ready 256-query pass, including cache resets, lookup/write/read, query transfer, original traversal/allocation/sort, complete result return/free/synchronization; setup/index/mapping/warmup/oracle/files excluded and reported separately

statistics.interpretation: fixed query-set run variation, not distribution generalization; CI crossing1 is inconclusive

qualification: independent exhaustive oracle and frozen tie rule
cache reset/alternating queries/repeated-index and pointer churn
full-result audit for every formal process
fault_rule: Abort campaign at first hash drift, foreign GPU activity, failed lock, runtime failure or correctness failure. Preserve every rejected receipt. No repeated replacement seeking a faster run; any replacement requires a separately registered whole-round retry.
gpu_admission: User authorized physical GPU1; freeze its UUID and NUMA0 after live idle/lock admission; GPU0 service untouched; all timings freshly remeasured
novelty_gate: Existing GTS pivot-bound use is prior behavior. Distance caching is not assumed novel. This experiment tests implementation redundancy and complete net cost, not external superiority or dynamic updates.
